Believers are responsible for themselves; those who have strayed cannot harm them once guided, and all will return to Allah to be told their deeds.
Believers will not invoke what neither benefits nor harms after Allah has guided them, for Allah's guidance is the only guidance; they are commanded to submit, pray and fear Him.
Most people on earth would mislead from Allah's way, following only assumption, and Allah knows best who strays from His way and who is guided.
Allah opens the breast of whom He would guide to Islam and constricts whom He would misguide; His path is straight, and those who remember have the Home of Peace.
They excuse immorality by their fathers and claim Allah ordered it, but Allah orders justice and sincere worship; some are guided, others took devils as allies.
Whom Allah guides is guided and whom He sends astray is lost; many jinn and people are made for Hell, with hearts, eyes and ears they do not use.
Allah does not let a people stray after guiding them until He makes clear to them what they should avoid.
If they deny the Prophet, each has his own deeds; some listen and look but are like the deaf and blind he cannot guide, and Allah wrongs no one.
The truth has come from the Lord; guidance or straying affects only one's own soul, and the Prophet follows the revelation and is patient until Allah judges.
To the demand for a sign, the answer is that Allah leaves astray whom He wills and guides those who turn to Him, whose hearts find assurance in His remembrance.
Allah shows the right way while some paths deviate, and had He willed He could have guided everyone.
Every religion has its rites; the Prophet should not let disbelievers contend but invite them to his Lord, for he is rightly guided, and Allah will judge their differences.
The Prophet cannot make the dead or the deaf hear, nor guide the blind from error; only those who believe in Allah's verses will hear.
The Prophet cannot guide whom he likes, but Allah guides whom He wills; some fear following the guidance would uproot them, though Allah gave them a safe sanctuary.
Allah will guide those who strive for Him to His ways, and Allah is with the doers of good.
Wrongdoers follow their own desires without knowledge, and none can guide one whom Allah has sent astray, nor will they have helpers.
The Prophet cannot make the dead or the deaf hear or guide the blind from error; only those who believe in Allah's verses will listen.
Some see their evil deeds as good, but Allah sends astray and guides whom He wills, so the Prophet should not perish in regret over them.
Some breasts Allah opens to Islam, others harden against His remembrance; His Book, the best statement, makes the God-fearing shiver then soften, guiding whom He wills.
The Prophet must follow an ordained way, not the desires of those who do not know; wrongdoers ally together, Allah protects the righteous, and this Quran is guidance.
Whoever takes his own desire as his god, Allah sends astray and seals his hearing and heart; none can guide him after Allah.
Allah sent a Messenger reciting His clear verses to bring those who believe and do righteous deeds out of darkness into light, and into gardens forever.
It was revealed that had they remained straight on the way, they would have been given abundant provision as a test; whoever turns from his Lord's remembrance faces arduous punishment.
Disbelievers love the fleeting life, though Allah made them and can change them; this is a reminder, yet none wills unless Allah wills; He admits whom He wills to mercy.
Allah has taken upon Himself to show guidance, and to Him belong the Hereafter and the first life.
